title: Prefix sum at the next coordinate
statement: Let $w$ be a Boolean vector of length $n$ and let $k<n$. Encode each bit as an element of $\mathbb{F}_2$, and let the prefix sum through index $k$ mean the sum of encoded coordinates with indices strictly less than the specified bound. The prefix sum with bound $k+1$ equals the prefix sum with bound $k$ plus the encoded bit $w_k$.
hypotheses_covered: $w$ is a Boolean vector of length $n$
